text:
Ravi Singh: Quick heads-up: we're doing a combined CI auth + Jira sync migration next month. TL;DR: retire PATs for CI, move service auth to GitHub Apps / OIDC, and replace AzDO->Jira build status webhook with a GH Actions -> Jira app integration. Migration guide: https://go/redwood/ci-auth-jira.
Priya Nair: Timeline?
Ravi Singh: Dry-run Sat 2026-05-02 03:00-05:00 UTC. Production cutover Sun 2026-05-10 02:00-06:00 UTC. See calendar.
Tom Alvarez: Which repos are in-scope?
Ravi Singh: All repos that trigger deploy pipelines and any repo with a jira/deploy-status step (we'll auto-detect). We'll DM owners before making changes.
Nina Koh: For service accounts that still use PATs, what's recommended migration path?
Ravi Singh: Preferred: GitHub App installations for CI services. Secondary: OIDC tokens for cloud providers. PATs will be revoked for org CI on 2026-06-01. If you need an exception, file #help ticket with justification.
ci-bot: ACTION: Run `./infra/scripts/ci-auth-check.sh --org redwood` by 2026-04-28 to flag PAT usage and non-OIDC auth.
Tom Alvarez: Any change to runner permissions or labels? Our deploy job expects runner=deploy-node.
Ravi Singh: Runner labels unchanged, but org policy will enforce `self-hosted` + `redwood-{env}` labels for autoscaling. Update workflows to use `runs-on: [self-hosted, redwood-prod]` where applicable.
Priya Nair: How will Jira statuses be written? We currently rely on AzDO webhook.
Ravi Singh: GitHub Actions will call the new reddit/actions-jira step (internal action) which posts deployment statuses back to Jira and comments on the ticket. Example:```yaml
name: deploy-status
on: workflow_run
jobs:
  post-jira:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: redwood/actions-jira@v2
        with:
          jira_project: PROJ
          issue_key: ${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}
          status: "Deployed to prod"
```
Nina Koh: Will the action require additional permissions?
Ravi Singh: Yes, install the org Jira app (doc covers minimal scopes). The action will use a short-lived installation token issued by the GitHub App. No long-lived tokens stored.
Tom Alvarez: Are there rollback plans if the Jira bridge fails and tickets get spammed?
Ravi Singh: The action has idempotency keys and rate limits; we also added a dry-run mode. If we detect >50 failures in 10m during cutover we'll auto-disable the step and fallback to a manual post deploy job.
ops-bot: NOTE: We will provision a staging Keycloak realm for testing. Invite link: https://id.redwood/stage-keycloak
Priya Nair: Secrets migration questions: AzDO variable groups -> Vault -> GH Secrets?
Ravi Singh: Yes. Canonical store is Hashi Vault. We'll sync necessary secrets into repo-level sealed GH Secrets via the secrets-sync job. Document section: "secrets-sync" shows CLI example: `vault read -field=token secret/ci/service`
ci-bot: REMINDER: Repos with direct SPN usage will have 30 days to migrate before SPNs are rotated.
Tom Alvarez: Who's the escalation on call during the cutover?
Ravi Singh: Pager rota: Priya Nair (primary), Tom Alvarez (secondary). I'll be on standby. Use #eng-platform for coordination and escalate to #incidents if outage.
Nina Koh: Any pre-cutover checklist?
Ravi Singh: Yes: 1) run ci-auth-check.sh 2) install Jira app in test org 3) confirm OIDC role mappings for cloud accounts 4) update workflows to new action names 5) open PRs for secrets migration. Checklist link in doc.
deploy-bot: Plan created: ci-auth-jira-migration-1842204321. Playbook: https://ci.redwood/migrations/1842204321
Priya Nair: ack :thumbsup: I'll start running the check against product repos today.
Tom Alvarez: I'll prep the runner AMIs and autoscaler changes.
Ravi Singh: Thanks all. Short pre-cutover sync Wed 2026-04-29 15:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.
